ns2:section.sectionText: Chainsaw Safety & Directional Felling Techniques will provide NRES undergraduate students with instruction and hands-on training specific to chainsaw safety, saw maintenance, directional felling, limbing, and bucking. This class will meet at the Dixon Springs Agricultural Center in Simpson, IL during spring break (March 18-22). Transportation, housing, and meals will be provided. This course will charge a field trip fee.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Natural Res & Env Sci department.
